scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @solocamiones/api" "npm run dev -w @solocamiones/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @solocamiones/api && npm run build -w @solocamiones/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @solocamiones/api && npm run typecheck -w @solocamiones/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @solocamiones/api && npm run test -w @solocamiones/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w @solocamiones/api && npm run test:unit -w @solocamiones/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration -w @solocamiones/api && npm run test:integration -w @solocamiones/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @solocamiones/api && npm run test:coverage -w @solocamiones/web
